top_statements.query: INSERT INTO core.event ( event_pk, aggregate_sequence_number, event_type, schema_version, aggregate_pk_ref, aggregate_type, occurred_at, actor_pk_ref, actor_type, prior_value, new_value, reason_code_fk, source, correlation_pk_ref, correlation_type, metadata, prior_event_hash, event_hash ) VALUES ($1
SELECT a.status, coalesce(sum(b.balance_minor_units), $1) FROM ar.account a LEFT JOIN ar.account_balance_bucket b ON b.account_fk = a.account_pk WHERE a.account_pk = $2::uuid GROUP BY a.status
SELECT reference_value_pk FROM core.reference_value value JOIN core.reference_type type ON type.reference_type_pk = value.reference_type_fk WHERE type.code = $1 AND value.code = $2

SELECT event_pk, global_sequence_number, event_type, aggregate_pk_ref, aggregate_type, occurred_at, new_value, metadata FROM core.event WHERE global_sequence_number > $1 AND global_sequence_number <= $2 AND event_type = ANY($3) AND (hashtext(aggregate_pk_ref::text) & $4) % $5 = $6 ORDER BY global_se
SELECT CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE $1 END, pg_postmaster_start_time()::text || $2 || current_database() FROM core.seq_event_global_sequence
SELECT account_pk FROM ar.account WHERE account_pk BETWEEN $1::uuid AND $2::uuid ORDER BY account_pk
SELECT last_global_sequence_number FROM core.projection_checkpoint WHERE projection_name = $1
UPDATE core.projection_checkpoint SET last_global_sequence_number = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE projection_name = $2
SELECT pending_event_pk FROM core.pending_event WHERE status = $1 AND due_at <= clock_timestamp() AND (hashtext(pending_event_pk::text) & $2) % $3 = $4 ORDER BY due_at LIMIT $5
